titulo: Primark to launch home delivery service in Britain
cuerpo: Retailer says trading in Europe ‘challenging’ but customers are responding well to its price-cutting campaign Business live – latest updates Primark will offer home delivery in Britain for the first time, as the fast-fashion retailer prepares to spin off from its owner Associated British Foods (ABF). The clothing chain, which already offers a click and collect service in the UK, has long avoided home delivery, arguing that its low prices made it too difficult to absorb the cost of packing and shipping orders.
